items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: Well, Otto Hardwick was there. He hadn't left yet. And, of course, Harry was there.

ctx.x: But Johnny and Harry still, they wanted Hilton Jefferson in there in Hardwick's place.
I can remember when Toots Mondello was for many years at CBS and every time we spoke he always had such great regards for Hilton Jefferson and for Johnny Hodges --
